subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional append?: boolean on the existing write tool, or require a different model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The need for an append primitive is well supported, but the permanent write-tool API shape is a maintainer-owned product/API contract decision.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve append?: boolean as the smallest default-preserving extension and land this PR once current-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a different API shape
options.body: Ask for a mode field or separate append tool if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Pause for a narrower replacement
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if another open candidate becomes clearly safer and fully proven.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve append?: boolean as the smallest default-preserving extension and land this PR once current-head CI and owner review are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history signal for agent runtime and tool API direction among the likely owners.
